name: Zibad Smart Notifier
author: zibadmend

sections.description:
Smart Notifier is a powerful and lightweight WooCommerce plugin that enables store owners to send automated SMS notifications for various order events. Improve customer experience by keeping them informed about their order status in real-time.

External services

This plugin integrates with external SMS gateways (such as Twilio) to send notifications. To use these services, you must have an account with the provider. Please review their terms and privacy policies:

  • Twilio Privacy Policy: https://www.twilio.com/legal/privacy
  • Twilio Terms of Service: https://www.twilio.com/legal/tos

Features

  • Automated notification workflows for WooCommerce events.
  • Customizable message templates with dynamic placeholders (e.g., order ID, status, total).
  • Integration with Twilio SMS gateway.
  • Delivery logging and status tracking for all sent messages.
  • Clean, developer-friendly architecture and easy setup.
  • Fully GPL compliant and free to use without functional locks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zibad-smart-notifier directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings from the Zibad Smart Notifier menu.
sections.faq:
Does the free version require a license?

No. The free version works without any license or registration.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.
